routeIdentity.finding: The family's own artifacts disagree on the route key, and the key the participant-facing pages print does not exist. production-field-map.json, participant-instructions.md and the Route: line printed on the pages of both fixtures carry "obligation:track-pathway:KY:ky_void_seal_controlled_substance:void-and-seal", while product-wiring.json and the MASTER_QUEUE row carry "obligation:track-only:KY:ky_void_seal_controlled_substance". The canonical route universe (data/rcap-grade-a/route-obligation-census-candidate/canonical-route-universe.json) contains only the track-only key; the track-pathway:...:void-and-seal key occurs zero times there. The statute, jurisdiction and track id all agree, so this is a keying defect, not a wrong-route packet - but a Grade-A record must be keyed to an exact route, and the face and field map are keyed to a route that does not exist. Repair: re-key production-field-map.json and participant-instructions.md to the canonical track-only key and rerender so the printed Route: line matches; every other one of this verifier's obligations passes on the current bytes.
